notes.title: How this English edition relates to the Chinese monograph
notes.text: This English edition is authored as a meaning-equivalent monograph rather than a literal sentence-by-sentence translation. It shares the same canonical evidence bindings, claim digests, equations, worked cases, and 32-chapter, 5-topic, 5-appendix structure as the Chinese edition, while adapting prose, terminology, and audience notes for international readers.

notes.title: Original 1974 US customary units and SI equivalents
notes.text: To keep every numerical check directly auditable against the 1974 US EPA report (EPA SW-91c), this chapter retains the report's original US customary units. For international readers: 12 fluid ounces ≈ 355 mL, 1 short ton (2,000 lb) ≈ 907.185 kg, and 1 million Btu ≈ 1.055 GJ.

notes.title: Institutional context for China's 2002 cleaner production discussion
notes.text: For international readers: Qihong Sun's 2002 paper appeared as China enacted its Cleaner Production Promotion Law (2002) and adopted ISO 14040–14043 as the national standards GB/T 24040–24043. In Part I, this chapter serves as a historical lens on how international LCA frameworks were received when domestic life cycle inventory databases were still nascent.

notes.title: Chinese regulatory and bibliometric terms used in this chapter
notes.text: For international readers: Five-Year Plans set China's binding national total-emission control targets; the 'Two Control Zones' designate national Acid Rain and SO₂ Pollution Control Zones; 'GB/T' denotes voluntary national recommended standards (distinct from mandatory 'GB' standards); and 'CNKI' (China National Knowledge Infrastructure) is China's primary academic journal database, meaning the 243-paper Xie et al. (2022) tally reflects a Chinese-language scholarly subset rather than an industry-wide census.

notes.title: Note on GB/T 24067-2024
notes.text: For international readers: GB/T 24067-2024 is China's national voluntary standard for product carbon footprint quantification, structurally aligned with ISO 14067:2018. Like ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14067, and EN 15804+A2, its copyrighted full text is not reproduced verbatim here; formal conformity filings must consult the current authorized standard.
